data.name: Pavan Zalani
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Pavan Zalani has made a big mark in cricket. With 8 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 38*, with an average of 18.00 and a quick strike rate of 126.76. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 3 sixes and 9 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 3.3 overs, taking 2 wickets at an economy rate of 15.14. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
